messages:
Samir Khatri: quick follow-up from the DR tabletop this morning. We have recurring remediation items to track: overlapping route-policy updates, snapshot replication gaps, and unclear restore acceptance checks — need owners + short ETAs.
Elena Novak: agreed. My notes: (1) policy overlap causes ~30s blackholes when control-plane and DNS swaps coincide, (2) ~6 snapshots missing cross-region copies (replication filter), (3) restore runbook lacks an automated CHECK_REPLICA step.
Priyanka Desai: I'll own snapshot replication fixes + verifier script. Plan: add `snapshots/` to replication filter, ship `tools/snap-verify.sh` that outputs CSV and supports `--fix`. ETA: scan today, repair tomorrow.
Ben Holt: I'll take routing rollout changes. Proposal: add a HOLD/DRain step before applying policies and a short weight-ramp after. Canary in eu-west, run 3 flaps vs baseline. Prototype nginx snippet below and will open a PR.
Ben Holt: ```
# nginx traffic-hold sketch
map $upstream_health $weight {
  ~5xx 10;
  default 100;
}
proxy_next_upstream_tries 2;
```
Run results will include `failover_convergence_ms`.
Runbook-Bot: Jira EPIC RINF-2891 created: "DR continuity: routing, snapshots, runbook" by Samir Khatri.
Priyanka Desai: PR link for verifier (draft): https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/678 — dry-run first, `--fix` queued.
Ben Holt: PR for routing hold logic will be posted to infra/proxy PR soon. Need access to `canary-eu-west` for canary. @Samir Khatri can you grant?
Samir Khatri: granted `canary-eu-west` to @Ben Holt.
Priyanka Desai: I'll include example output CSV fields: snapshot_id, source_region, expected_copies, copies_found, repair_job_id.
Ben Holt: canary plan: 3 control-plane flaps, 10m ramp tests, compare `failover_convergence_ms` to baseline. ETA results + logs in 48h.
Priyanka Desai: scan completes tonight; repair window scheduled for tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC (dry-run first).
Samir Khatri: Runbook owner? We need CHECK_REPLICA SQL + exact acceptance criteria.
Elena Novak: I'll update the runbook with SQL checks, expected ms thresholds, and a post-restore smoke test. Draft by Fri EOD.
Samir Khatri: owners recap & timeline: Priyanka = snapshots & verifier (scan tonight, repair +1d), Ben = routing hold + canary (48h), Elena = runbook + acceptance criteria (Fri EOD). I'll track EPIC RINF-2891 and run weekly syncs until closed. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
